# Accessibility rules — apply to all UI code
Priority ladder: Click UI component or Radix primitive → semantic HTML element → HTML + minimal ARIA → full WAI-ARIA APG pattern (name it in a comment). Never a div with an onClick.
MUST  Every interactive element is a <button>, <a href>, or form control, keyboard-operable, with an accessible name that includes the visible label. Icon-only controls take aria-label (IconButton supports it).
MUST  Dialog/Menu/Popover: move focus in on open, trap while open (Dialog only), restore focus to the trigger on close, Escape closes.
MUST  Composite widgets (Tabs, Menu, Select, Grid) use ONE Tab stop and arrow keys (roving tabindex or aria-activedescendant).
MUST  Text color comes from design tokens; contrast is verified at 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text, UI parts, focus rings).
MUST  Announce async results and errors: aria-describedby for field errors, a live region for toasts and status.
MUST  Disabled native controls set both disabled and aria-disabled="true". Elements that cannot take disabled (<a>, role="tab") or must stay focusable use aria-disabled="true" alone. Decorative icons have aria-hidden="true"; an icon that is the only content has a label.
MUST  Rest props and ref land on the focusable element (button, input, a), never on a wrapper div. Consumer aria-label, aria-labelledby and aria-describedby are honored, never overwritten; merge ids when both exist. A ReactNode label is wired with <label htmlFor> or aria-labelledby, never stringified into aria-label.
MUST  Every interactive component ships stories for focus-visible, disabled and error states, plus one play function that drives it with the keyboard.
MUST  Every major transition or animation is disabled or reduced inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce).
MUST NOT  Positive tabindex. aria-hidden on focusable elements. outline: none without a :focus-visible replacement. Placeholder as the only label. role="menu" for navigation. ARIA that duplicates native semantics. <label htmlFor> pointing at a non-labelable element (div, span). Radix asChild onto a non-focusable element.
MUST  An inline eslint-disable jsx-a11y/* carries a reason. A file listed in eslint-suppressions.json is frozen per rule by count, so read its JSX by hand instead of trusting green lint.
MUST  Before declaring done: the Storybook Accessibility panel (axe) reports zero violations, `yarn lint` passes with jsx-a11y at error (frozen violations live in eslint-suppressions.json, which should only shrink), and a manual Tab / Shift+Tab / Enter / Space / Escape pass (plus arrow keys where they apply) is done. State what was not tested.
ESCALATE to a human, do not implement alone: data grids, tree views, drag-and-drop, rich text editors, toasts and live regions.
NEVER claim "fully accessible". List the WCAG 2.2 criteria you checked.
